directories.src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib: Contains 10 module files (BukkitSerialization.java, CooldownManager.java, CustomTag.java, ClaimUtil.java)

script/createLinesplot.py.summary: `script/createLinesplot.py` processes user-inputted performance data and generates a matplotlib line plot. It exports `get_user_input` and `plot_data` to visualize gametick and scheduled metrics.

deploy.sh.summary: `deploy.sh` automates the Maven build, packaging, and deployment of Minecraft plugin JARs to local and remote server directories. It serves as the project's primary deployment and distribution script.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Bukk.summary: `BukkitSerialization` provides `toBase64` and `fromBase64` to convert Bukkit `Inventory` objects to and from Base64 strings, facilitating persistent storage of player inventories within the project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Cool.summary: `CooldownManager` tracks and manages player-specific ability cooldowns. It provides `init(Plugin)` to initialize the background task that processes and updates active cooldown states across the project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Cust.summary: `CustomTag` implements the `Tag` interface to manage custom collections of `Keyed` objects. It provides static methods like `getOrCreate` and `createNew` for registry-based tag management.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Clai.summary: `ClaimUtil` provides `getItemStackClaimInfo` to generate formatted `ItemStack` representations for auction claims. It serves as a utility for displaying claim details within the project's UI.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Inve.summary: `InventoryMenu` manages custom GUI interactions for players. It provides `isSameInventory` and `init` to handle inventory events, serving as the core framework for interactive menus in the project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Item.summary: `ItemBuilder` provides a fluent API for creating and modifying Bukkit `ItemStack` objects. It serves as a utility class to simplify complex item customization throughout the project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Holo.summary: `Holo` manages persistent holographic `ArmorStand` entities. It provides `init()` to register a global update scheduler that handles entity lifecycle, gravity, and custom tick logic for all active holograms.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/MCMe.summary: `MCMethods` provides utility functions for Minecraft development, including `healthBalkenJSON` for UI rendering and `bukkitToNMS` for item conversion, serving as a core helper class for cross-version compatibility.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/NMSH.summary: `NMSHelper` provides utility methods like `getTags` and `addElementToTag` to manipulate Minecraft registries and tags via reflection, facilitating low-level NMS operations within the project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/mklib/Mkli.summary: `Mklib` is the main entry point for the `mklib` plugin, initializing core systems like custom enchantments, GUIs, and packet handlers to extend Minecraft server functionality.
